purpose: Algorithmic qualification framework to eliminate unviable products and select scalable 7d-90d winning DTC items

visual_hook_score.description: 3-second scroll-stopping power on TikTok/Meta feeds, Before-vs-After contrast, or ASMR audio/visual satisfaction.

margin_multiplier_score.description: Retail price (MSRP) divided by landed product cost (FOB + shipping). Minimum 4.0x multiplier required to support Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).

logistics_density_score.description: Gross weight < 500g and compact non-fragile packaging. Maximizes air packet margin and minimizes 3PL fulfillment costs.

seasonality_alignment_score.description: Alignment with target time horizon (7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, 90d) and seasonal weather/holiday cycles.

competition_moat_score.description: Degree of custom branding defensibility, giftability, or unique bundling not easily commoditized by Temu direct price war.

risk_resistance_score.description: Absence of sizing issues, fragile glass, hazardous liquid, or extreme return rate triggers (<3% expected refund rate).

tier_s_super_winner.action: Immediate full-scale budget allocation: launch 5-10 ad angles, setup customized Shopify landing page with upsell bundles, prep 1000+ units air/sea.

tier_a_strong_candidate.action: Rapid test batch: 100-300 units via dropship or air express, test 3-5 creative video concepts on TikTok/Meta.

tier_b_conditional_test.action: Requires packaging redesign, bundled accessory, or higher perceived value before ad spend.

tier_c_disqualified.action: Pass / Reject. High shipping cost, low margin, or saturated marketplace competition.

hard_disqualification_filters: Strict trademark / copyright infringement (Disney, Nike, Marvel, Apple, etc.)
Unsealed chemical liquids, corrosive flammables, or uncertified ingestion hazards
Fragile glass without shockproof mold packaging (>8% break rate during transit)
Gross weight > 1.8kg with retail price < $30 (shipping eats 100% of profit)
Gross margin multiplier < 3.2x (inevitable net loss after ad CPA and transaction fees)
